steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: Why should I help you, Sarkaz?

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: Do you think you saved me? I didn't die, though that doesn't even matter—this shell is merely a plaything I abandoned long ago.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: Besides, aren't the Sarkaz the ones hunting me down?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: How much history have you seen?

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: All that I have experienced.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Rumors say that you will divulge a piece of truth, or hint at an omen.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: You tiny little creatures treat my drifting ripples as hallucinations while indulging in them, and yet you harbor resent?

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: After I was divided up by those lunatics... there's even a fallen angel carrying a part of me around, and what I've seen and heard since has actually gotten more interesting.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: On the contrary, what makes me feel absolute boredom are these so-called... bulky histories and profound topics.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Absolute boredom... you're not wrong on that.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: History always repeats itself on this land. Looking at the past is now a means of looking towards the future.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: And so, I have actually become a prophet! In this life of mine—if you can still count my current form as the same life as before—I've never thought of having such an identity.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Then... are you looking for a 'new conclusion'?

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: Just how old do you think I am? You little rascal.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: There won't be any new conclusions to draw, with the way all of you look like now.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: Yes, something strange has happened to these decrepit bones of mine. A rabbit wears a Sarkaz's crown, and she together with a male Banshee are fighting a Vampire on top of my head.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: Of course, there's that sheep playing with shadows who hangs out with you too.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: Are these new to me? A little, perhaps.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: But you can't win.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You seem so sure.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Do we also belong to the history you've seen, that has comes full circle time and time again?

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: There's never been a shortage of those who resist on this great land, but they always fall into the same trap.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: Besides, I understand that Vampire's tricks. He was the one who peeled off my skin back then.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Let's have a wager, Feranmut.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: This strange bunch of people—Cautus, Caprinae, Banshee, Sarkaz; they'll triumph over the Vampire that tried to hunt you.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: Are you trying to win my favor? Do you think I'll look at you differently for helping me?

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: I couldn't care any less about that. But what are you putting on the table?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: If we win, you'll lend us your help, and bring us back to where we came from.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: And if you lose?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We'll all be dead by that point.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: You're making an empty offer, little thing.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: I accept.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You really are easy to talk over.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: No, it's because I know that all you have are just the waves I toss up, that will calm to a still in the blink of an eye.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: So I might as well spare a little effort and raise my eyelids a little.

a.text: You have indeed won, by a miniscule move. But the bet is far from over.
Did you really win? Did you triumph over the enmity, slaughter, and blood that Vampire represents?
Why don't we expand our wager by a little?
I'll bring all of you back.
And then continue to waiting for you in the cycles of history.

options: How long have they been gone?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Three hours and fourteen minutes.

options: Even a Sanguinarch can bleed and die, right?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You should trust them.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's all we can do.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We're done with our combat mission too.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Our losses aren't light. Their forces here are indeed well-trained.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Most of the Sarkaz chose to fight to the end, but a small number also chose to surrender.

options: You can hand them over to W's mercenary squad.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No, I'm not doing that.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It seems like you want me to make my own decision.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That's how I wish to do so, and so does the rest.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But I refuse to let them die so simply just like that.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Perhaps it's difficult to put them on trial during wartime.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's definitely a difficult task to judge just how much blood is on the hands of every terror-stricken Sarkaz who laid down their arms.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But if we act just like they do, then we'll be no different than them.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Vina, I'd like to take on the responsibility of investigating the crimes committed by these Sarkaz prisoners of war.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I have a professional covert intelligence background too, so I'm well versed in the ways to get them to talk.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I know what you're worried about, I...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No, I'm not.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'll leave it to you.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I won't let a single drop of blood go unaccounted for.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Prepare for battle. The Feranmut will be back soon.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr, standby.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There's no way we can be sure who'll be on this return trip.

a.text: The gigantic skeleton finally reappears.
The torrents of time seem to have washed away any trace of battle, and it hovers in the air, no different than it was at any other point of time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr!
Hey! Let go of me, you damn—
Ugh. Seems like that old hag's awake. Think you got her backing you up now?
That's my last grenade, so bite onto it tight, you little freak!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Angry howling)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Put her down, Mon3tr.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Shitty luck today.

steps.name: W
steps.text: *sigh* I just wanted to give myself a ceremonial salute to announce my return—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Didn't think I'd see an old hag with a scowl on her face once the skeleton stopped.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: W, don't forget we have to repair any structures you blow up here after taking over the place.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Anything destroyed will be fixed by the same hand.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Huh? What makes you think I'd even know how to fix this kinda thing?!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Kal'tsit, Doctor.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We've captured the Feranmut's skeleton, as well as Commander Ulšulah.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The rest of the skeleton garrison have been eliminated.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: So you're the  Dame Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: I've heard so much about you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're one of the Scar Market's people.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: ...You know every little thing that's happening in Kazdel clearly, even from somewhere as far as Victoria.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Seems like those old guys weren't lying.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'll have a talk with those 'old guys', as you call them, through you when we're done with business here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: They are the ones who stayed behind to watch over Kazdel, and the Lich have already contacted the Military Commission that currently governs the place.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: They'll be making their decision soon.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor!

a.text: The little Cautus crashes into your arms.

options: There's blood all over you. Are you hurt?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm fine. The blood... it was the Vampire's.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your rings... you used them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let me see your hands.

a.text: A ring on Amiya's hand has already disintegrated, leaving not even a trace or fragment.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... had to use it against him. I'm sorry.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...You've become more skilled with using emotions and memories.

options: Amiya, you fainted from releasing a ring before.
Kal'tsit, we need to run another check on Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, Doctor. Don't worry.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm just... kind of tired.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The ring on your right index remains broken. Fortunately, that's just an effect of exerting yourself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You were burning from rage again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Me.. angry?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I thought I'd be angry at the Sanguinarch of Vampires for slaughtering so many people.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But what I felt was not just that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There was also... sadness.

a.text: Sadness.
Kal'tsit pauses briefly and a pair of pink eyes always hiding sadness within flashes through her memory.
A few seconds after, she comes to her senses and takes a second look at Amiya fingers.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: These rings are meant to help you adapt to the Lord of Fiends' power, and the surge of emotions that come with it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Another ring has cracked.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Perhaps... we can do nothing but to witness these wounds open again and again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please don't worry, Dr. Kal'tsit. No matter who I've faced, or who I will face next...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I won't fall before they do.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: the Sanguinarch of Vampires fell into someplace we don't know about.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: His court still remains, but no longer poses a threat to us.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: However, we failed to prevent the curse from being cast.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's coming from Londinium... what's happening over there?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Self-Salvation Corps originally believed that cutting off this supply line would be a way to end the war.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But things have changed. This 'war' will not last for much longer.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We need to hurry over. This skeleton might be able to become a new stronghold, or an unprecedented means of transport.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Hopefully it can be put to good use.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The decisive battle is right before us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mhm. The Sarkaz cannot be the culprits of the next calamity.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Also...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit. The Vampire's obsession, his hopes, and what he called a curse, is 'Originium'.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The oldest Kazdel came into contact with 'Originium' before any other civilization did.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It was not the remnants of a Catastrophe, or a mineral silently buried within rock formations. It was a hunk of 'Originium' from antiquity.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And it birthed the oldest witchcraft, and the most ancient of... Infected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If the Vampire really knew of this fact, and developed his obsession from that, thinking it could grant him power...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Then it won't just be Londinium's fate that will be determined next.

steps.name: Percival
steps.text: Back here again.

steps.name: Percival
steps.text: Londinium.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Yeah, after all we've been through... we're finally in Victoria's capital.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: A pity it's now completely surrounded by the Sarkaz and the Dukes' armies.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Guard, quickly arrange...

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Percival, arrange another Oripathy screening for our members. I know some of them are still deteriorating.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Non-combatants will be stationed in this forest. Percival, take good care of them and keep in touch with us.

steps.name: Percival
steps.text: ...Are we really going in there?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: The Infected will be everywhere throughout the city, no matter how the war ends.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Sarkaz or Victorian, soldiers or nobles, and even farmers, workers, traders. They won't be able to judge their own identity so quickly.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Perhaps they won't even realize it until peace returns and they're once again marginalized, and then it hits them.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I was reminded of this... because of what happened to Guard.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: But, no matter.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: We have to let every Infected on this land know that our flag flies high once again.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: And more importantly, what it stands for.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Once day, when they become prisoners again, they will think of our flag as they realize the justice on this land must be won through struggle.

steps.name: Percival
steps.text: What's the plan?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: We'll split up. It won't happen overnight.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Other people can handle the task of eradicating the disease, while we'll make sure oppression will no longer be tolerated. We'll need to directly demonstrate this with our strength.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: In Victoria, we need to at the very least—

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ——Nine.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: There's fire on the other side of the hill, a hundred or two hundred meters away at most.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's glowing an unnatural hue.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: ...Percival.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: How long has it been since the scouting team last replied us?

steps.name: Percival
steps.text: Huh? Let me go check...

steps.name: Percival
steps.text: ...Yeah, it's been longer than our estimations. But this isn't the first time, our comms equipment are just junk after all.

steps.name: Percival
steps.text: I'll go ask Red...

a.text: Talulah stares at the flames.
There is no reason or omen. Only a strong feeling.
She smells the stench of death cast by the firelight.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: I didn't know Your Highness would be here in person.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: This is only a trifling swarm of Infected with weapons. Weak and pitiable people forced to unite and fight.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: ...Heh. Even if there is a surviving Draco among them?

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: We'll confirm her identity and handle everything on your behalf.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: I'm not blaming you, of course.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Hmm... have the scouts located the target?

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Yes. It's consistent with our intel.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: However, with all due respect—why do we have to be so concerned about her this much?

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: Even if she has the red dragon's blood—her 'identity' will only pose a slight detriment to your claim.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: But if our intel is accurate, her current identity is that of an 'Infected'.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: So what does she mean to...

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: An Infected, hm?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Don't we know another Infected Draco as well?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: My sister will soon return to my side.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Just think of it as eliminating some unnecessary variables to nourish the soil between us.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: We can—

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: A Draco.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Hehe... I've never come into contact with a Draco outside of family before.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: All of you, wait here.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: I shall take a look myself.

steps.name: Worn-out Infected
steps.text: Ah—

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Careful.

steps.name: Worn-out Infected
steps.text: ......Thank you.

steps.name: Worn-out Infected
steps.text: This swamp is miserable to wade through.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Our supplies are low, and people aren't getting enough to eat. We haven't been able to get any decent medication either.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Do you need my help?

steps.name: Worn-out Infected
steps.text: No, no thank you.

steps.name: Worn-out Infected
steps.text: I walked all the way from Ursus, and this isn't so different from back then.

a.text: Talulah's footsteps slow down.
The group slowly marches next to her through the shrubs and reeds.
The rustling sounds are quieter than silence itself.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Nine.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Can you release these... restraints? And your Arts too.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You should be well aware you're not allowed to use your Originium Arts. These are your yoke and fetters.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You're 'Talulah, the Hero' only when before our Victorian compatriots.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm not a hero, or anything like that.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I just don't want history to repeat itself because of m—

a.text: She does not finish her sentence.
Flames of death ignite from the depths of the swamp, encircling the group in their confusion.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Wh-What's going on?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Where did this fire come from?!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: All units on alert!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: What is that—

a.text: An ominous deep purple climbs up Nine's body before she can finish speaking, engulfing her in death instantly.
Cold flames of death swallow everything.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: ...'Reunion'. Infected.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Another group of pitiable people, fighting against their pitiable fate. Tenacious, powerful, magnificent.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: And yet completely unaware they're involved in another lamentable conspiracy. Draco and Aslan, red dragon and lion.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: You people, who rose up from Ursus, were actually lead to where you stand today by a descendant of the red dragon.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Who will ultimately bring about your demise.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: 'Talulah Artorius'. What sort of woman are you, Draco?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: If you're deserving of my attention, then come forth from death.

a.text: Sparks fly as death's voice, with dead branches and reeds all reduced to ashes.
...But the flowers are still in bloom.
They are rejecting death.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Flowers?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: To think there would even be... flowers that can withstand my flames?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Nine.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: These flames are special.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: She came for me, so I'll handle her.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Many of us here aren't combat-ready.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You have to keep them all safe.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Reunion will pull on your chain.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You haven't been judged, so don't die just yet.

a.text: Her flames of death are cut open.
No. Her death is blocked by delicate vegetation, ignited by flames of fury.
Fire ignites fire.
The Infected turns away from her.
She has never been ignored like this before.
Eblana comes to her senses at once.
The gaze of the Draco named Talulah never shifted away from her.
Raging flame cleaves into mortal flame.
Emotion rends emotion.
Talulah tears into Eblana.
The void is now awash with blood.
Eblana laughs.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Talulah Artorius, daughter of Edward, and legitimate heir to the Victorian throne.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: This is—

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Your true self.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We have nothing to do with each other, Draco of Dublinn.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Is that for you to say?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Just look at you, red dragon. How strong and powerful you are.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: And yet despite your might, you once again willingly toss aside the glory of the red dragon to the Aslans so easily, to let them trample on the red carpets of Westhaleg?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Victoria is a country founded by Draco, Talulah.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Why do you only resist?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: I can smell an unimaginable fury in your flames.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Do you not crave it? How can that be?!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Fury?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Do you still wish to continue playing house with the Infected? How are you this narrow-minded!

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Infected? This status does not merit mention. You can step over it, disregard it, save it.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: I give you a chance now, Talulah.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: I can disregard your Infected status, and even this pitiful mutual aid program you control.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Your flames move me, Talulah. Stand with me, and I pledge that everything you desire shall be realized into reality.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Come to my side, submit to me, and Tara shall stand together with you.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Our careers hold no conflict with each other at all. Both you and this Infected movement of yours need an end more powerful and prosperous than this.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Are you finished speaking?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Draco.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Your eyes have only desire in them.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: A desire to free Tara, exact revenge on Victoria, fulfil your own desires, or perhaps...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You have yet to even grasp what exactly lies in the depths of your desires.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Fury... It's true, and I won't deny it.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And that's why...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Come any closer, and my flames will consume you whole.

a.text: Fire.
Fury.
A calm fury.
It burns at the extremities of her death.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm not interested in the Draco's lineage, power or the country.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Do you lead the Tarans' resistance with such a narrow-sighted desire and ideals?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If so, then perhaps it's better if I just cut you down, here and now.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Truly a pity.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Uninterested in lineage, power, nor country.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Our history summarized. An imaginary crown, an instigated resistance. Well said.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Perhaps I don't know what's going on? Or could it be... do you think I'm indulging myself with my actions?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: You shall be my most powerful vassal, though my other subjects are eager for me to kill any other living Draco to uphold my 'legitimacy'.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: But they don't know why exactly I wish to establish a nation.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And you know it yourself?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: And my sister will do it in my stead.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Don't leave your affairs for your family to do, Draco.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You're the one ruining the lives of others with utter disregard.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Death is only my prisoner.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: No death is taken for granted, or without meaning.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: All with power will die worthy deaths.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Is that up for you to decide?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Haven't you realized yet that your manners, gentleness, affection, and even your arrogance and scorn are all fake?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You're just a hypocritical tyrant despite your bombastic words.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Death is just a scepter for you to brandish your authority, and you're not the first tyrant I've met either.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Stay away from Reunion.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: What an extremely dull answer.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: But your answer will change in the end, so it'd be a pity for you to die here.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: 'Reunion'. Indeed, those flowers death could not burn earlier are equally deserving of affection.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: So, what if I tell you... Dublinn's forces will exterminate every last one of Reunion's members if you refuse to submit to me...? What will you do then?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Do you wish for us to be enemies?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: I don't know what happened in the time you spent drifting about Ursus after leaving Victoria, but I can feel it.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: From your flames—strong and weak, profound and superficial, angry and remorseful.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: She's a sinner from Reunion.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Don't think too highly of yourself, Draco.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Ah. The little flower.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Your team's not too far away. You must be so concerned for her.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: It doesn't matter, this isn't the first time Reunion is up against a strong foe.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Dublinn's forces? You already erred by not calling in your high-speed battleships immediately.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: We'll kill you before your drones arrive. I'll do my best, and everything it takes to kill you.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Your desires and ambitions—we don't care for them, and I'm in no mood to listen to your red dragon chat with Talulah.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: All I know is that you'll die.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: For sure.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Enough with that look. All of us have no wish for this to continue, right?

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: —Alright, Talulah, other descendant of the red dragon.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Even if you reject me, and your actions have wholly nothing to do with my Tara...

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: But your fury, resistance, desires and answers—your end lies me with too.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Let us treat today's meeting as a first prophecy.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Tara's loyal servants shall come here one after the other.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Go, Reunion. Bring some chaos to Victoria, and create some opportunities for us.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: The next time we meet...

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: One red dragon is bound to bite the other to death.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's enough hiding. Come out already.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's only going to become more humid after night falls, and you won't be able to light the firewood you got.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: Who... are you?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...You're Infected.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Doesn't matter, I'm the same. I won't harm you or anything.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: There's no need to be so wary. I'm not lying, I really am Infected.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: You're... not a Victorian?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm from Yan.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: What's a Yanese doing here?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: My family came here for business and got caught up in the war. I was going to evacuate with them, but I accidentally contracted Oripathy.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So they left me behind.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: Hmph. Everyone's unfair to the Infected everywhere. Your luck sure sucks.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: But we can't help you either.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I can tell.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You don't even have a way to start a fire, so you're probably no Arts users.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't seem to be hunters either, so you won't live more than a few days.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Getting captured by the military as an Infected, or by the Sarkaz as a Victorian, either way is a terrible way to go, right?

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: So?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I can help you get a fire going at least.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Watch.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: Woah! It's really burning! It was that easy?

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: Thank you so, so much, Yanese lady.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: What about you? Do you need us for anything?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The sky's getting dark. Can I rest here for the night?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll leave at first light tomorrow.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: How's a foreign refugee like you this calm and unruffled?

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: And your sword... even I can tell it ain't some ordinary blade.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're right... I'm what they call a zoubiao in Yan, like the Messengers here.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm pretty skilled, and not a stranger to traversing adverse conditions either. Surviving in the wild isn't that difficult for me.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: You helped us start a fire... I'll leave it at that.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: *sigh*...I'll admit what we did, even if it's the soldiers who find out. As long as the Sarkaz don't catch us.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: It's not like they'll reward you with a feast.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: Is that worth discussing when we don't even have a crumb to eat right now?

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: Those Reunion crazies... they're the reason why it's so dire for us now...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Reunion?

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: You haven't heard? Well, you've only been recently Infected, after all.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: They're a band of Infected, and we were all counting on them to be our saviors.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You fought over something?

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: Bah.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: We robbed a Sarkaz, but they were of the opinion that we killed one of their Infected 'countrymen'.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: Sarkaz? Countrymen? My daughter's dead because of them!

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: My daughter... my girl... *sigh* Oh!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Do they have a leader...?

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: 'Nine'.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: Yeah. She's the one who chased us away.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: There was another one they called Guard, but he's dead.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: ...Grr. I really want to roast something for dinner.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: I don't know what Reunion is exactly, but the group we encountered were a bunch of hypocrites who belong in a dumpster.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: What? Heh, you want me to shake hands with the Sarkaz and make peace? I'll beat the next one I see to death.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: Right, remember the rumors we always heard? From the Ursus tundra?

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: ——Talulah?

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: 'Hero of the Infected'? She didn't seem much at all to me.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: I remember she was always trailing behind Nine, and never said anything more than a few words.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: The hearsay from those old Infected weren't worth shite. Nine might have been the actual decision maker all along.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: ...*sigh*. This is all just useless banter. It's too late for you to join them, Yanese fella.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Where did they go?

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: And how would I know?

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: Back then I left in a huff with this guy in tow. I remember there being a Messenger station in this direction about a dozen kilometers from here.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: An early rest for us today then.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We have to get back on the road tomorrow.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier A
steps.text: ...Nothing unusual to report.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier A
steps.text: Did you hear? The dukes seemed to have bumped into each other.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier B
steps.text: Duke Windermere sacrificed herself, and the other lords can no longer sit still either.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier B
steps.text: *sigh* The madam's legendary tale is still in my mobile terminal...

steps.name: Victorian Soldier A
steps.text: Legends are useless now.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier A
steps.text: But... do you know who was keeping watch here at Chetleigh before we took command? I thought the Sarkaz seized this place long ago.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier B
steps.text: Could they have been stragglers from some army? Maybe it's the Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps. Rumors abound that they're still active.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier A
steps.text: That's ace. They managed to stand up to the Sarkaz even though there's no decent equipment to be found here.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier B
steps.text: Yeah. They're definitely veterans roaming about the country who can take on a hundred alone.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier A
steps.text: Right? No way they're just some local thugs or worker riffraff.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier A
steps.text: The scouts sent their intel.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier A
steps.text: Basically it was pretty much what the commander predicted... which was 'impossible to predict'.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier A
steps.text: Meh. Send it to the tent, I can't make heads or tails of it either. The Sarkaz army's methods are just too unconventional.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier B
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier A
steps.text: ...Wait.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier A
steps.text: The scouts say they detected a strange squad identification code.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier B
steps.text: Want to report it together?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier A
steps.text: 'The Exemplars'?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier A
steps.text: Isn't that name from the War of the Four Nations...?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier A
steps.text: What am I supposed to tell them? Our scouts saw a specter?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: ...'The Exemplars'.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Know anythin' about them?

steps.name: Injured Soldier
steps.text: No... I'm from the Duke of Fife's 4th infantry battalion...um. That's no longer important.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Aye, you're just an Infected now, and I'm basically a deserter...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Haha, we're both in a wee bit of a pickle, aren't we? Didn't think I'd have to be so overcautious here in Chetleigh.

steps.name: Injured Soldier
steps.text: Bagpipe... I can't find this funny at all.

steps.name: Injured Soldier
steps.text: Chetleigh's now under the army's jurisdiction, so are we...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: ...Sigh.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I'm sure you have no clue how enchantin' the hay piles are this time of year. I want to celebrate with me army chums back home too.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: But I can't expose myself so easily like that. They treat deserters no better than fowlbeasts on the chopping block for dinner.

steps.name: Injured Soldier
steps.text: You're a good one, miss. I'm sure you can sort this misunderstanding out...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Tell me that a year back and I might have believed ye.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: 'The Exemplars'...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: ...Ain't that the Tempest Platoon's former name?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Still following me?

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: Uhm.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: You seem strong... and we haven' eaten at all the past two days...

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: We're all fellow Infected, aren't we?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We'll travel together for a while more.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You might be able to see the station you mentioned after this hillside.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: Or maybe it's been smashed to bits... wait.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: Look, over there. People, right?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Stay calm. Their numbers are limited, at the very least.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: Wait, hold on! They're Victorians! I can see them!

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: Are they a squad of refugees? I can see some soldier guards too!

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: What do we do?

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: This is much better than running into Sarkaz, but we're Infected... are we going to be...

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: The Infected already abandoned us, so we might as well ask them for food than starve to death out here.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: B-besides, think about it. How many people are going to emerge from this war with Oripathy? Surely they'll let us live somehow?

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: Of course. Definitely. For sure, I'm sure they will.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: I'll go take a look.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: Heavens! What's going to happen if the soldiers do turn hostile?

spans.text: Heavens! What's going to happen if the soldiers

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: And, um, you're a Yanese... what if...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...I think you can ease up on the anxiety.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Look. They seem to be getting along well.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: I-it really does look like it. He's waving, I'll go over.

a.text: Ch'en watches the two Infected mingle with their compatriots.
Vigilance, talking, casual chatting.
Soon someone puts their arm on their shoulders, and their cheery chatter reaches Ch'en's ears.
Ch'en stays at her spot for a long time.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: Yanese lady!

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: I talked with them, we can travel together—

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: Huh. Where'd she go?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: 'You beat a Sarkaz to death? Hell yeah, you're our heroes!'

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: You finally replied to my invitation, Duke Gododdin.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: It seems that even you realize now how serious the situation is.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Yes, it's gotten so serious that our cautious Duke Caster has actually left her territory to grace the front lines in person.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: A Victorian Duke has died on the battlefield... how many years has it been since something like this has happened?

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Quite a few of our fellow nobles suspect you behind your back, you know. After all, everyone knows you never got along with the Duke of Windermere.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: That stubborn Windermere would never support your little plot to take over Londinium.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: But I know it wouldn't be you.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: You welcome any loss she suffers, even if they were major. But now... your problems have only increased with her death.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: In fact, all of us here have attracted a big problem.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: There are rumors from outside that the young Duke Gododdin today is obsessed with notions of romance and lacks the wisdom and wits of his house.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: It seems that our country has become so weak that we've exhausted our ability to understand people.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Don't flatter me, I'm only disinclined to care about other matters, yours included.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Alas. Why does this war compel us to face our responsibilities? All I can do is to walk out the winery and throw myself down at the table of today.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: And for this end I've even brought a friend.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: It was not easy to bring him off his high-speed battleship.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: To think the Duke of Wellington would grace us with his presence.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: My time grows short.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: I hear you met with some troubles on the frontline. The Nachzehrer King is not an easy enemy to deal with.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: No more than just a Sarkaz.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: You must take care of yourself. After all, you're already...

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: I'm not at the age where I need you to tell me how old I am.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: The stalemate on the frontline will soon end, and Windermere's defeat will have a... minimal impact on the war situation.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: We will be able to retake the frontlines in no time.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Your valiant march onwards has caused the ducal armies to clash with the Sarkaz military on all fronts.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: It's not enough.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: We must execute an effective offensive than continue defending our fragmented defenses to win this war.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Our counterattack must begin.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: ...I agree.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: A rare sight to see the two of you in agreement.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Londinium is now officially declared to be under the Sarkaz's occupation. This means they no longer have a need to hide.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: This does not bode well for us at all.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: My follow-up units will assemble in three days.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: We suffered some losses in the previous war, but Wellington's battleships will still be the first to rush into the storm.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: I will participate as well. And see to it that the Dukes of Normandy and Fife join our efforts.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Abercorn and Ashworth will of course, also be reasonable people—

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: What an unprecedented sight to behold. The dukes speeding to Londinium on their battleships to shell the city walls.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Hmph, I hope there won't be a second time.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Inform your troops that I will take command in this battle.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Naturally.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Well then, if you will excuse me. There are many matters waiting for me to handle on the front line.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: And just like that. Truly a swift and decisive man.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: I grew up listening to the tales of 'The Empire's Death Knell', but I didn't think his hair would actually turn completely white.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: *sigh* Forming a military alliance with other dukes used to be an earth-shaking affair, but look at us now; we can't even have a presentable meeting.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Judging from his words, he's become a stubborn old man unwilling to admit his setbacks.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Duke Caster, I know nothing about war, but looking at old Wellington's condition, I fear we won't be able to completely trust him...

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Caster?

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Indeed... trust.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: No, it's nothing. I merely recalled some past events from my youth.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Old Wellington... he conceals his impatience, his unease, and even his shortcomings. He is getting older as well.

spans.text: Old Wellington... he conceals his impatience, his unease, and even his shortcomings. He

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: But he can't fool me. It's all fake.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: You've known him for a long time.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: For far too many years... even from when I was just a little girl with no experience.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: What are your thoughts on the matter?

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: The look in his eyes as he spoke of the Nachzehrer was exactly the same as it used to be in his youth.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Be it friend or foe, he is like a beast thirsting to tear the other to feast on their blood.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: To rip out their entrails, chew their bones, and swallow them.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Hunt, devour, grow. He has always been this sort of warrior.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: The old man's appetite has always been good.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Who was already in Duke Wellington's belly, when you met him?

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Ivan Evgenevich.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Herkunftshorn.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: As well as Corsica I.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: You were really... quite young back then.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: There used to be a saying in the among the nobles in Caster territory, regarded as an ominous symbol.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: 'Victoria only has one true Duke after the War of the Four Nations.'

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: For we restricted and weakened him after that fort more than sixty years. The people forget about heroes in peacetime, and the nobles repel the death knell in their fear.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: He revealed his fatigue earlier.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: But I think of, and I've always been thinking of something—the smile on his face when we were both young, flashed towards the endless expanse of the battlefront...

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: He stood side by side with the Emperor of Ursus, he witnessed the Witch King's arts, he saw the greatest of monarchs and dismantled the largest modern cities to exist then.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: How can someone like him willingly throw himself to the slaughter?

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: So you're telling me, our man who has had no choice but to swallow his pride for decades and might be still Victoria's strongest general, has divulged his true feelings?

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Heheh, you're the one who invited him to the table. You know he has a trump card up his sleeve.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: I'm feeling a little chilly. The wind outside tonight is rather strong.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Chilly? Be sure not to catch a cold, Duke Gododdin.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Ahaha, of course not. Please be at ease.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Despite what everyone says about me, I really am lazy and would much rather stay in my lovely estate appreciating the countryside view than to be on a battleship.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: But I do like winter.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Ah! I got it!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: You tinkering with the radio equipment again?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Didn't I already tell you multiple times, Closure?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Our recent patrols haven't gone far enough to pick up any signals coming from inside Londinium.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: And I already told you so many times, I'm a Rhodes Island engineer!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Look, my equipment specially made for Rhodes Island communications can now receive signals from other channels after my many modifications!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Let's see—

a.text: 'Londinium Self-Salvation Corps broadcast, *Electric current noise*. Repeat, Commander Clovisia and the other members who have not left are still fighting. Repeat, we need back up——'

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Commander Clovisia! I knew she and the others were fine!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: We need to hurry and tell everyone about this.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Great, they're all right and I'm done debugging this tool in my hand.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Wait, there's another message from the Rhodes Island channel.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It can't be... what happened to Blaze and the rest with her, and what's with all the regular Infected...

a.text: '*Electric current noise* The disembarkment application for Londinium, Victoria has been approved *Electric current noise* Local branch operators, please make preparations.'
'Repeat, please make preparations.'

steps.name: Beleaguered Mercenary
steps.text: So many books here, but not even a vegetable stem to be found.

steps.name: Starving Mercenary
steps.text: The number of books won't matter if we don't find any stems.

steps.name: Starving Mercenary
steps.text: Are you sure we can find something edible here?

steps.name: Beleaguered Mercenary
steps.text: If we don't, then we can just kick down some house door after.

steps.name: Starving Mercenary
steps.text: Won't they put up a fight?

steps.name: Beleaguered Mercenary
steps.text: We already took them all away.

steps.name: Beleaguered Mercenary
steps.text: (yawn) Man, I'm beat.

steps.name: Beleaguered Mercenary
steps.text: Life was so much simpler before.

steps.name: Beleaguered Mercenary
steps.text: Swing our sword, cut someone down, swing again, cut down another, and then boom. Money.

steps.name: Beleaguered Mercenary
steps.text: But now? We can't even find a single stem to eat.

steps.name: Starving Mercenary
steps.text: Is Londinium still considered Victoria's now?

steps.name: Starving Mercenary
steps.text: I mean, we occupied it, so does it count as a new city of ours now? Or is it still Victoria's?

steps.name: Beleaguered Mercenary
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Beleaguered Mercenary
steps.text: All I know is the clouds have been gathering lately. The top of that building... is extremely unusual.

steps.name: Starving Mercenary
steps.text: What's there to worry? That's where the regent is.

steps.name: Starving Mercenary
steps.text: Do you hear a... strange noise?

steps.name: Beleaguered Mercenary
steps.text: Huh? Nah.

steps.name: Starving Mercenary
steps.text: That's so strange...

a.text: A huge figure emerges from the shadows, and a ray of light blazes through the deathly still streets.
It raises it's heavy right arm, and then harshly drops it.
The armor falls into silence, like it was just an illusion. A faint fire seeping from its helmet is the only sign that it still lives.
She stretches out her hand to touch the knight, but is forced to refrain from the residual heat on the armor.
The armor remains silent.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Your Highness, what are you looking at?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Dark clouds.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The Shard's energy is gathered. According to the Confessarii research, a device like this able to manipulate Originium's reactions will also be able to control that piece of 'Originium'.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The dukes have begun mobilizing their forces, and in a few days...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: No, I don't mean the clouds here.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: What's about to happen in Londinium is set in stone.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Manfred, you were born in Kazdel. What does it look like in your memories?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: It was already the hub unit of your nomadic city while I was growing up.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: My memories of the place... the sky was always overcast. Even worse than Victoria's skies, to be honest. There was always a pungent stench of industrial waste in the air.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Would you call that place... 'home'?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I would.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Really.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I was thinking how we Sarkaz always travel within a haze.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: We are determined to tear the clouds apart...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But, when everything is finally revealed—

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The true calamity will follow.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Will we make it in time?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I hope the light I've been looking at can still shine then.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Even if I'm already in the depths of the darkness.
